labels.desc: List of the names of the regions.

maps.desc: Path to nifti file containing the atlas :class:`~nibabel.nifti1.Nifti1Image`. It is a 4D image  with shape ``(182, 218, 182, 48)`` if a :term:`Probabilistic atlas` is requested, and a 3D image with shape ``(182, 218, 182)`` and 48 regions (+ background) if a :term:`maximum probability atlas<Deterministic atlas>` is requested. In the latter case, the image contains integer values which can be interpreted as the indices in the list of labels.
